BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE
LAW REVISION ACT
(Chapter 1)
LAW REVISION ORDER NO.5 OF 2022
In exercise of the powers conferred by section 5(1) and (2) of the Law
Revision Act, the Attorney General hereby makes the following Order -
Citation and commencement
1. This Order may be cited as the Law Revision Order No. 5 of 2022 and shall
commence on the day it is made.
Inclusion of pages
2. The inclusion in the Laws is hereby authorised of the pages specified in the
third column of Schedule 1 hereto with reference to the written laws specified in
the first and second columns thereof and bearing on the face or overleaf the
legend specified in the fourth column thereof.
Removal and substitution of pages
3. (1) The removal from the Laws is hereby directed of the pages specified in
the third column of Part A of Schedule 2 hereto with reference to the written laws
specified in the first and second columns thereof and bearing on the face or
overleaf the legend specified in the fourth column thereof.
(2) The inclusion in the Laws is hereby authorised, in substitution of the
pages directed to be removed under sub-paragraph (1 ), of the pages specified in
the third column of Part B of Schedule 2 and bearing on the face or overleaf the
legend specified in the fourth column thereof, with reference to the written laws
referred to in the first and second columns thereof.
